canonical_project: KT Busan IDC (KTICC, near Busan Station)
notes: KT operates a Busan IDC/colocation point at the Busan Telephone Information Center (Jung-gu, near Busan Station) plus a Busan DR center linked to Seoul; Busan Ilbo (Apr 2026) lists KT among operators running DCs in Busan. Small/medium facility; capacity not published.
